! Type{{efn|Classification of electric utilities in the Philippines:
*'''EC-CDA''' – Electric utilities under the Cooperative Development Authority<ref>{{Cite news |last=Ravanera |first=Orlando R. |date=October 14, 2020 |title=The Greatest Social Injustice: Electric Cooperatives Are Not Cooperatives |work=Cooperative Development Authority |url=https://cda.gov.ph/updates/the-greatest-social-injustice-electric-cooperatives-are-not-cooperatives/ |access-date=June 15, 2021 |archive-date=June 10, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210610082853/https://cda.gov.ph/updates/the-greatest-social-injustice-electric-cooperatives-are-not-cooperatives/ |url-status=live }}</ref>
*'''LGUOU''' – [[Local government in the Philippines|Local government unit]]–owned utilities<ref>{{Cite journal |date=March 2019 |title=Feasibility Study on the Regulations for Implementing Quality Electricity Infrastructure in the Philippines |url=http://dx.doi.org/10.1515/9783034609722.136 |access-date=June 15, 2021 |website=Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry |publisher=KPMG AZSA LLC |page=3 |doi=10.1515/9783034609722.136 |archive-date=July 17, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210717160824/https://www.degruyter.com/document/doi/10.1515/9783034609722.136/html |url-status=live |url-access=subscription }}</ref>
*'''MPC''' – Multi-purpose cooperatives<ref>{{Cite web |title=Overview |url=http://www.magcoop.com/AboutUs#overview |access-date=June 15, 2021 |website=Magsaysay Multipurpose Cooperative |archive-date=April 11, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200411143838/http://www.magcoop.com/AboutUs#overview |url-status=live }}</ref>
*'''NEA-EC''' – Electric utilities under the [[National Electrification Administration]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=EC Categorization |url=https://www.nea.gov.ph/ao39/electric-cooperatives/coverage-areas |access-date=June 15, 2021 |website=National Electrification Administration |archive-date=May 12, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210512083414/https://www.nea.gov.ph/ao39/electric-cooperatives/coverage-areas |url-status=live }}</ref>
*'''PIOU''' – Private investor–owned utilities<ref>{{Cite web |last=Patalinghug |first=Epictetus E. |date=October 15, 2003 |title=An Analysis of the Philippine Electric Power Industry |url=https://www.ombudsman.gov.ph/UNDP4/wp-content/uploads/2013/01/An-Analysis-of-the-Philippine-Electric_Patilinhug.pdf |access-date=June 15, 2021 |website=Ombudsman of the Philippines |location=Diliman, Quezon City |page=3 |archive-date=May 17, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170517014853/http://www.ombudsman.gov.ph/UNDP4/wp-content/uploads/2013/01/An-Analysis-of-the-Philippine-Electric_Patilinhug.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref> or privately-/independently-owned utilities<ref>{{Cite web |date=May 2009 |title=Philippines: Rural Electric Cooperatives Development Project (TA 7012-PHI) |url=https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-document/65082/41067-phi-tacr.pdf |access-date=June 15, 2021 |website=Asian Development Bank |publisher=Snowy Mountain Engineering Corporation (SMEC) International Pty Ltd. |location=Australia |page=6 |archive-date=June 10, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210610082848/https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-document/65082/41067-phi-tacr.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref>
*'''SPUG-EC''' – Small power utilities group<ref>{{Cite web |date=August 30, 2017 |title=NPC-SPUG Electricity Rates |url=https://www.napocor.gov.ph/index.php/npc-spug-electricity-rates |access-date=June 15, 2021 |website=National Power Corporation |archive-date=June 10, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210610111509/https://www.napocor.gov.ph/index.php/npc-spug-electricity-rates |url-status=live }}</ref>
*'''SPUG-EC CDA''' – SPUGs under the Cooperative Development Authority}}
